description:
Idol star Park Jae-ha speaks to Lee Yeo-joo, who hummed a song that comforted her during her long hospitalization. Park Jae-ha, an idol star she had only seen on cell phone videos, speaks to her.  
"Let me help you, you need money for the surgery, right?"  
That's how Jae Ha became Yeo Joo's lifesaver and favorite. But five years later, he makes an extreme choice and ends his life... Shocked, Yeo Joo screams to the stars to save him.  
Her wish is granted, and she travels back in time seven years as a top idol judge of the audition program "I Am the Strongest Idol', possessing the body of Jang Boran' and among the auditionees is, Park Jae-ha!  
"Just like you saved me, I'll save you this time."
